```yaml
name: Azure Deployment

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.8'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest

    - name: Deploy to Azure
      uses: azure/login@v1
      with:
        creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

    - name: Build Docker image
      run: docker build . -t kouchou-ai:latest

    - name: Push Docker image to Azure Container Registry
      run: |
        az acr login --name kouchouaiacr
        docker tag kouchou-ai:latest kouchouaiacr.azurecr.io/kouchou-ai:latest
        docker push kouchouaiacr.azurecr.io/kouchou-ai:latest

    - name: Deploy to Azure App Service
      uses: azure/webapps-deploy@v2
      with:
        app-name: kouchou-ai-app
        slot-name: production
        package: .
```
